description: Webview panel with strict CSP, nonce-gated script, typed message protocol, and @vscode-elements UI.
agentsNotes: - **Webview** (`src/features/panel`, `src/webview`, `src/shared/protocol.ts`): every message crossing the boundary is a member of the discriminated unions in `src/shared/protocol.ts` and is validated with its type guard on receipt. HTML is built only in `panelHtml.ts` (CSP `default-src 'none'`, nonce-gated script). Browser code type-checks against `src/webview/tsconfig.json`.
